meta.notes: A jigsaw block names a template pool, and the game picks one of its elements by weight: here the flower bed two times in three and nothing (empty_pool_element) otherwise. rigid keeps a piece's shape; terrain_matching bends it to the ground, which suits paths. fallback is the pool used when a piece does not fit or the structure is at its size limit. Point a jigsaw block's pool at msm_examples:garden_pieces to use it.
